alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 31 at 8:29PM PDT until November 1 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Seattle WA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Eastern Kitsap County, City of Seattle, Downtown Everett /
Marysville Area, Eastside, Lowlands of Lewis and Southern Thurston
Counties, Lowlands of Pierce and Southern King Counties, Olympia
and Southern Puget Sound, and Shoreline / Lynnwood / South Everett
Area.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 10 AM PST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Dense fog is expected to develop tonight and
continue into Sunday morning for areas of Puget Sound. Localized
freezing fog may also occur as temperatures fall into the 30s for
many locations.

sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.
